rules.statement: A writ cannot lie if the disputed facts are within a contract or subject to private law and a specific remedy is available.
rules.supporting_quote: What is here sought to be done is the enforcement of a Contract of employment, contracts of employment are enforceable by ordinary action and not by judicial review. In the circumstances the dispute as to the contract of employment is solely a matter within the purview of Private Law and not a matter for judicial review.
